doc.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Early gig in Boston with Tiny Grimes
summary: A televised Boston gig with guitarist Tiny Grimes while at school.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well you ended up, what was the first big gig for you?
Yeah. I mean you know, playing with big people, you know, like 280 pounds or something. Never mind, sorry, bad joke.

Well that’s tough. I remember one time in Boston when I was going to school I did a gig with Tiny Grimes that got televised, and that was funny, because a friend of mine broke a table laughing so hard when he watched it at home.

I don’t know it was just one of those college things you know, your buddy’s on TV playing with this old guitar player that used to play with Art Tatum. I don’t know, they thought it was funny. I probably did look pretty funny.
